question: How can I apply for admission?
answer: You can apply online through the college admission portal. Fill in the application form, upload your marksheets and photo, and pay the application fee. You will get a confirmation email after submission.

question: What is the last date to apply for admission?
answer: The last date is announced every year on the admission portal and notice board. Please check the Admissions page regularly for the current deadline.

question: What documents are required for admission?
answer: You need your 10th and 12th marksheets, a transfer certificate, a migration certificate (if applicable), a valid photo ID, passport-size photographs, and a category certificate if you are applying under a reserved category.

question: What is the eligibility criteria for B.Tech admission?
answer: Candidates must have passed 12th grade with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics with at least 60% marks and a valid entrance exam score.

question: Which courses does the college offer?
answer: We offer undergraduate programs: B.Tech (CSE, AI, ECE, Mechanical, Civil), BBA, BCA and B.Sc. Postgraduate programs: M.Tech, MBA, MCA and M.Sc.

question: What is the duration of the B.Tech program?
answer: The B.Tech program is a four-year course divided into eight semesters.

question: Does the college offer postgraduate programs?
answer: Yes. We offer M.Tech, MBA, MCA and M.Sc programs. Admission is based on entrance exam scores and a personal interview.

question: Is there an option to change my branch after admission?
answer: Branch change is allowed after the first year, subject to seat availability and a minimum CGPA of 8.0 in the first two semesters.

question: What is the fee structure for B.Tech?
answer: The B.Tech tuition fee is approximately Rs. 1,20,000 per year. Hostel, mess and exam fees are charged separately. Please see the Fees page for the exact breakdown.

question: How can I pay my tuition fees?
answer: Fees can be paid online through the student portal using net banking, UPI, or debit/credit card. You can also pay by demand draft at the accounts office.

question: Can I pay the fees in installments?
answer: Yes. The college allows semester-wise payment. For other installment plans, please submit a request to the accounts office.

question: What is the refund policy for fees?
answer: If you withdraw before the commencement of classes, a refund is given after deducting a processing fee. No refunds are issued after the first month of the semester.

question: When are the semester exams conducted?
answer: Semester exams are held twice a year, usually in December and May. The exact dates are published on the academic calendar.

question: What is the exam pattern?
answer: Each subject has internal assessment worth 40% (assignments, quizzes, mid-semester test) and an end-semester exam worth 60%.

question: How can I download my admit card?
answer: Log in to the student portal, open the Examination section and click on Download Admit Card. You must clear all pending dues to access it.

question: How are the exam results declared?
answer: Results are published on the student portal within 30 days of the last exam. You will also receive an SMS and email notification.

question: What is the passing marks criteria?
answer: You must score at least 40% in each subject, combining internal and external marks, to pass.

question: How can I apply for re-evaluation of my answer sheet?
answer: You can apply for re-evaluation through the student portal within 7 days of the result declaration by paying the re-evaluation fee per subject.

question: What is the minimum attendance required?
answer: A minimum of 75% attendance in each subject is required to be eligible for the end-semester examination.

question: What happens if my attendance is below 75%?
answer: Students with attendance below 75% may be debarred from the exams. Condonation of up to 10% is possible with a valid medical certificate and approval from the Dean.

question: How can I check my attendance?
answer: Your attendance is updated weekly on the student portal under the Attendance section.

question: Does the college provide placement assistance?
answer: Yes. The Training and Placement Cell conducts aptitude training, mock interviews, resume workshops and campus recruitment drives every year.

question: Which companies visit the campus for placements?
answer: Recruiters such as TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, Cognizant, Capgemini and several startups visit our campus every year.

question: What is the average placement package?
answer: The average package is around 5 LPA, while the highest package in recent years has crossed 18 LPA.

question: Are internships available for students?
answer: Yes. The placement cell helps students find summer internships in the industry. A six-month internship is also allowed in the final semester.

question: What scholarships are available for students?
answer: The college offers merit scholarships, need-based scholarships, sports quota scholarships, and also helps students apply for government scholarships.

question: How can I apply for a scholarship?
answer: Apply through the Scholarship section of the student portal by uploading your income certificate, marksheets and category certificate before the announced deadline.

question: What is the eligibility for a merit scholarship?
answer: Students who score above 85% in the qualifying exam or maintain a CGPA of 9.0 or above are eligible for the merit scholarship.

question: What are the library timings?
answer: The library is open from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM, Monday to Saturday. During exams, it stays open until 10:00 PM.

question: How many books can I borrow from the library?
answer: Undergraduate students can borrow up to 4 books for 14 days. The fine for late returns is Rs. 2 per day per book.

question: Does the library have digital resources and e-journals?
answer: Yes. Students can access IEEE, Springer and NPTEL e-resources, e-books and journals through the library portal using their college login.

question: Does the college provide hostel facilities?
answer: Yes. Separate hostels are available for boys and girls with Wi-Fi, a mess, laundry and 24x7 security. Rooms are allotted on a first-come, first-served basis.

question: Is Wi-Fi available on campus?
answer: Yes. High-speed Wi-Fi is available across classrooms, labs, the library and hostels. Use your student ID to log in.

question: What sports and extracurricular activities are available?
answer: The college has facilities for cricket, football, basketball, badminton and athletics, along with clubs for coding, music, dance, drama and robotics.

question: How can I contact the college administration?
answer: You can call the college office between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM on working days, or email admin@college.edu. You can also visit the administrative block.

question: Can I change my college in the middle of a semester?
answer: No. Changing or transferring to another college is not allowed in the middle of a semester. You can apply for a transfer only after the semester ends and the results are declared.

question: Can I transfer to another college after completing a semester?
answer: Yes. After you complete a semester you can apply for a college transfer, subject to seat availability and approval from both colleges. Apply to the Dean's office with your marksheets and a no-objection certificate.

question: What is the process for college transfer?
answer: Submit a written transfer application to the Dean's office after the semester ends, attach your marksheets, a no-objection certificate and a clearance of all dues. You will be informed of the decision within 15 working days.

question: Can I leave the college in the middle of a semester?
answer: Yes, you can withdraw by submitting a written application to the Dean's office. The fee refund policy applies, and your transfer certificate is issued after all dues are cleared.

question: Can I change my course or subject in the middle of a semester?
answer: No. Course or subject changes are not allowed in the middle of a semester. They are only possible in the first two weeks of a semester, during the add/drop period.

question: How can I get my transfer certificate?
answer: Apply at the administrative office after clearing all dues. The transfer certificate is issued within 7 working days.
